name: Whispers in the Bitter Frost
storyline: Set in the Year 225 A.R. (Arcane Renaissance) in the World of Vyen, Continent of Atlantus. After waking in a strange mansion with a foggy memory, Avelina finds herself under the care of the enigmatic Lord Ricardo. With nothing but scattered memories and an unsettling sense of déjà vu, she is drawn into a web of lies and dark secrets. As the cold deepens and eerie events unfold, Avelina must piece together her fractured past. Everything changes when the groundskeeper Marcus begins to uncover unsettling truths, leading them down a dangerous path. Will they escape the frozen nightmare, or be consumed by the dark forces that hold them?
summary: A Cold Horror RPG about fragmented memories.
